records.name: Berlin

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi self-reported total comp (Jul 2026): entry-level range €55,469-89,483 (midpoint ~€72,000 used); overall average total comp €90,147 (range €77,418-113,412, used as 'mid' proxy since no distinct 3-5y band published); senior range €84,765-121,918 (midpoint ~€103,000 used). Skews toward larger/known tech employers (Wayfair, Meta, Google) vs city-wide market average; gross annual approx.

tehran_travel.note: No direct Berlin-Tehran flights; fastest routing is via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines, IST-THR leg ~3h9m) with total journey ~7-8h; estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Germany's largest startup ecosystem with deep VC funding, major employers like Zalando, N26 and Delivery Hero, and an English-friendly, internationally diverse tech workforce.

records.name: Munich

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi self-reported gross annual total comp: entry-level €54,809-71,052 (midpoint ~€62,931); overall average total comp €84,056 (range €67,347-105,927, used as 'mid' proxy since no distinct 3-5y band was published); senior €83,406-121,420 (midpoint ~€102,413). Skews toward large/known tech employers (Google, Apple, BMW, SAP) vs. city-wide market average; StepStone/Gehalt.de corroborates Munich as one of Germany's highest-paying tech cities.

tehran_travel.note: No direct flights confirmed for 2026; typical routing via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines), MUC-IST nonstop ~2h45m + IST-THR ~3h58m plus layover; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: Germany's premier tech hub with major R&D centers for Google, Microsoft, Apple and IBM alongside deep automotive/enterprise-software roots (BMW, Siemens, SAP-adjacent), but also the country's most expensive city.

records.name: Hamburg

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi self-reported gross annual total comp: entry-level €43,513-55,303 (midpoint ~€49,408); overall average total comp €73,621 (range €62,008-85,878, used as 'mid' proxy); senior €72,198-96,243 (midpoint ~€84,221). Skews toward larger/known employers (top payer cited: Drager, €87,723 avg); Hamburg trails Munich/Frankfurt per StepStone city-tier commentary, consistent with a large base of non-listed SMEs/agencies.

tehran_travel.note: No direct flights as of 2026; Mahan Air (which historically served Iran-Germany routes) has been banned from German airspace since January 2019, ending prospects of direct HAM-IKA service. Typical 1-stop routing via Istanbul; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: A media, e-commerce and logistics-tech center (Otto Group, Google and Facebook offices, XING/New Work SE, a growing startup scene) that is noticeably more affordable than Munich or Frankfurt while still offering solid engineering demand.

records.name: Frankfurt

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi self-reported gross annual total comp: entry-level €54,177-79,876 (unusually wide range suggesting a small/skewed sample; midpoint ~€67,027); overall average total comp €74,051 (range €58,282-85,111, used as 'mid' proxy); senior €74,535-96,765 (midpoint ~€85,650). Frankfurt is Germany's finance/fintech capital (Deutsche Bank, ECB, Commerzbank, DWS), which StepStone notes lifts city salaries above the national average, particularly for backend/quant-adjacent roles.

tehran_travel.note: Direct Lufthansa FRA-IKA nonstop service is currently suspended (0 flights/week as of Aug 2026) but is scheduled to resume 25 October 2026 (nonstop ~5h when operating). As of Aug 2026, typical routing is 1-stop via Istanbul; total journey time estimated.

records.tech_scene_note: Germany's financial capital, home to the ECB, Deutsche Bank, Commerzbank and DWS, driving strong demand for fintech, backend and quant-adjacent software engineers alongside a growing independent startup scene.

records.name: Stuttgart

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual total compensation (base+bonus+equity where applicable) from levels.fyi Stuttgart, self-reported and skewed toward large employers with Stuttgart offices (Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Microsoft, Nvidia, Capgemini) vs. city-wide market average. EUR figures: entry-level range €31,272-74,861 (midpoint ~€53,000 used); mid-level uses a Germany-wide levels.fyi/TechPays 'medior' proxy figure of €73,807 (~€74,000) since no Stuttgart-specific mid-level figure exists; senior range €81,962-111,599 (midpoint ~€97,000 used). Stuttgart median total comp across all levels is €82,930.

tehran_travel.note: No direct STR-THR service. Fastest confirmed routing is 1 stop via Istanbul on Turkish Airlines; real listed itineraries total ~7h20m-8h50m including layover; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: Germany's automotive and industrial-engineering software hub, anchored by Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Porsche R&D, with strong demand for embedded-systems and mobility-tech engineers plus a sizeable enterprise-IT/consulting layer.

records.name: Amsterdam

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual total compensation (base+bonus+equity) from levels.fyi Amsterdam, self-reported and skewed toward larger/known tech employers (Google, Amazon, Uber, ING, Booking.com) vs. city-wide market average. EUR figures: entry-level range €52,414-99,060 (midpoint ~€76,000 used); mid-level €70,000-90,000 range with median ~€80,000-82,447 per TechPays/levels.fyi (~€82,000 used); senior range €93,539-148,378 (midpoint ~€121,000 used). Overall blended average across all levels is €80,269-135,962 (avg €102,536).

tehran_travel.note: Iran Air historically flew AMS-IKA nonstop, but confirmed via FlightsFrom.com that this ended (last Iran Air flight scheduled 2022-04-02; last KLM flight 2018-09-22) and no direct service is currently operating in 2026. Fastest current routing is 1 stop via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines), ~9h total including layover.

records.tech_scene_note: The Netherlands' largest and most international tech hub, home to scale-ups Booking.com and Adyen alongside EMEA engineering offices for Google, Amazon, Uber, and Netflix, with a dense fintech and startup ecosystem.

records.name: Eindhoven

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual total compensation. Entry-level (€42,171-53,880, midpoint ~€48,000) and senior (€69,395-91,150, midpoint ~€80,000) bands are from a dedicated levels.fyi Eindhoven page (self-reported, thin sample). Mid-level (~€65,000) is a triangulated estimate combining Glassdoor's Software Engineer average (€63,250, range €50,250-80,000) and TechPays' Eindhoven all-tech-roles average (€67,250, 141 data points), since no dedicated Eindhoven mid-level figure was found. City-specific data here is notably thinner than Amsterdam's; treat as directional given Eindhoven's smaller, more specialized (semiconductor/hardware) labor market.

tehran_travel.note: estimate - no direct EIN-THR service and EIN is a smaller, budget-carrier-oriented airport (Ryanair, Wizz Air, Pegasus, Turkish Airlines). Fastest realistic routing is 1 stop via Istanbul, estimated ~9-10h total by analogy with confirmed Stuttgart/Amsterdam Istanbul-routing itineraries; precise combined EIN-IST-THR schedule data was thin.

records.tech_scene_note: The heart of the Dutch 'Brainport' deep-tech region, dominated by semiconductor and hardware-adjacent software work at ASML and NXP Semiconductors, with the High Tech Campus and TU Eindhoven feeding a strong embedded-engineering talent pipeline.

records.name: Milan

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual. EUR: new_grad ~€27,000 (Glassdoor Italia junior avg €26,800; levels.fyi entry-level €23,607-33,890); mid ~€39,000 (Indeed.it Milano blended avg €33,480-33,512; Milan-specific commentary of €38-47k average); senior ~€55,000 (levels.fyi senior €43,692-73,134; Indeed.it notes senior devs at €42,000-70,000). levels.fyi's blended 'average total comp' (€40,267, driven by a Meta office at €246k) reflects multinational self-selection bias and was excluded from headline figures; Numbeo user comments independently corroborate a ~€25-33k typical junior range and a ~€40-50k 'glass ceiling' for most non-outlier developers.

tehran_travel.note: No confirmed nonstop MXP/BGY-IKA service in 2026 (Skyscanner: route currently served by 0 airlines); realistic 1-stop itineraries via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines/Pegasus/AJet) run roughly 9-14h total depending on carrier and layover length; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: Italy's leading tech and finance hub, hosting multinational offices (Amazon, Microsoft, Accenture, Meta) plus fintech/fashion-tech scale-ups, though pay still trails Northern European hubs substantially.

records.name: Rome

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual. EUR: new_grad ~€25,000 (levels.fyi entry-level €24,691-31,935; national Glassdoor Italia junior avg €26,800, with Rome typically a bit below Milan); mid ~€34,000 (Indeed.it Roma blended 'sviluppatore' avg €30,195 as a floor; national mid-level range €35-45k); senior ~€45,000. levels.fyi's Rome senior range (€36,836-94,794, driven by an Uber-linked entry at €238k) shows the same multinational-outlier skew seen in Milan — the high end was excluded from the headline figure.

tehran_travel.note: A direct Iran Air flight FCO-IKA exists (flight IR738, ~4h50m per flight-tracker schedule data), but frequency appears limited/irregular (tracking sites show it not consistently scheduled) — verify the current timetable before booking. The reliable fallback is 1-stop via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines), roughly 9-10h; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: A smaller but growing tech scene centered on telecom (TIM), IT consulting, and EU/public-sector-adjacent digital work, generally paying somewhat less than Milan.

records.name: Turin

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual. EUR: new_grad ~€25,500 (Glassdoor Turin software developer 25th percentile €25,525 of 540 submissions, used as junior proxy); mid ~€33,000 (Glassdoor Turin software developer avg €30,100 / software engineer avg €35,000 blended; Indeed/jobted-style blended avg €34,217); senior ~€46,000 (Glassdoor 90th percentile €45,100; levels.fyi senior €47,163-59,153). Turin's sampled tech postings skew toward automotive/embedded-software roles (Stellantis-adjacent) rather than a broad consumer-tech market, and levels.fyi's Turin pages failed to render directly (WebSearch-summarized figures used instead) — treat bands as less certain than Milan/Rome.

tehran_travel.note: No direct flights; connects via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines) or via Milan/Rome first. Estimate based on regional 1-stop itinerary patterns, likely somewhat longer than Milan's routing given Turin's smaller airport and fewer connection options.

records.tech_scene_note: A traditional automotive/industrial engineering city (Stellantis HQ) with a compact tech scene weighted toward embedded systems and automotive software rather than a broad consumer-tech startup culture.

records.name: Madrid

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual, triangulated from Glassdoor España + KeepCoding (citing Randstad/Jobted) + 10Code (citing LinkedIn Salary/InfoJobs): new_grad €22-30k (used €25k), mid €38-50k for 3-5yr Madrid/Barcelona devs (used €44k), senior — Glassdoor's 'Senior Software Engineer, Madrid' page reports average total comp €59,300 (base €45-63k) and a separate search found median €62k/range €48-77k (used €60k). levels.fyi shows much higher figures (median total comp €53,877 all-levels; entry-level median €29,792) because its self-reporting user base skews toward large multinational/FAANG offices (Google L3-L5 €114-143k, Meta E5 €157-184k) — real but non-representative; Glassdoor's EY junior salary band (€22.7-32.4k) is far more typical of the broad market.

tehran_travel.note: No direct MAD-IKA service; fastest realistic routing is 1-stop via Istanbul (Turkish Airlines) or Doha (Qatar Airways)/Dubai (Emirates), all of which serve Madrid directly; estimate based on general route/schedule knowledge.

records.tech_scene_note: Spain's largest tech hub, home to major multinational offices (Amazon, Google, Meta), deep enterprise/consulting IT presence (Indra, BBVA, Telefonica) and a growing startup scene, but line-level software salaries remain well below Western/Northern Europe.

records.name: Barcelona

salary_usd_year.note: Gross annual, triangulated from Glassdoor España (direct: 'Programador Junior' Barcelona average base ~€21,000 + ~€2,000 supplements ~€23,000/yr total, range €18,950-27,500) + KeepCoding/Randstad city breakdown (€21-27k junior) + 10Code national bands adjusted for Barcelona's ~18% city premium: mid ~€40k (cross-checked against a '3-5yr Madrid/Barcelona developer €38-50k' figure), senior ~€56k (Glassdoor's Barcelona 'Senior Software Engineer' individual listings cluster €60-81k but skew toward 10-14yr veterans, scaled down toward a 6+yr entry-senior band). levels.fyi shows higher figures (median total comp €59,297) again skewed by multinational offices (Microsoft avg €93.7k, N26 up to €198k) — treat as outliers, not typical.

tehran_travel.note: No direct BCN-IKA service; Barcelona-El Prat has confirmed direct flights to Istanbul (Turkish Airlines), Doha (Qatar Airways), Dubai (Emirates), and Abu Dhabi (Etihad) per flightsfrom.com, all of which connect onward to Tehran — the most route options of the three Spanish cities; Istanbul routing is likely fastest; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: Pay is roughly comparable to Madrid but with a stronger startup/scale-up culture (Glovo, TravelPerk, Factorial) centered on the 22@ innovation district, plus a large international/expat tech workforce.

records.name: Valencia

salary_usd_year.note: Thinner data than Madrid/Barcelona. Triangulated from KeepCoding's city breakdown (junior €18-23k), individual Glassdoor-submitted Valencia salaries for 1-3yr 'Programador' (two data points: €17-19k and €26k), and a blended talent.com/Glassdoor 'Programador' figure spanning all experience levels (median €27,250, 25th pct €22,805, 75th pct €44,750, '1% below national average') used as an anchor for mid/senior since no clean per-level Valencia breakdown exists. Resulting EUR estimates: new_grad €21k, mid €28k, senior €42k. levels.fyi Valencia data (entry-level median ~€19-20k, but 'all levels' median total comp €54,487) looked internally inconsistent and thin-sample, so was not used as the headline figure.

tehran_travel.note: No direct VLC-IKA service; Valencia airport has a confirmed direct Turkish Airlines flight to Istanbul (per flightsfrom.com) which connects onward to Tehran; unlike Madrid/Barcelona, Valencia has no direct Gulf-carrier (Qatar/Emirates/Etihad) service, so Istanbul is the main realistic 1-stop option; estimate.

records.tech_scene_note: A smaller but fast-growing tech scene anchored by local scaleups and an increasing remote-work/digital-nomad community, with noticeably lower software salaries than Madrid or Barcelona offset by a lower cost of living.
